event.hazel_heart6.after.text: I checked your face just now. It stayed kind. (I'll answer Ione by Friday. Thursday, if I'm brave.)
event.hazel_heart6.after.why: drops the second 'Slowly' (wren_hazel_2 owns it) and leaves a day attached

dlg.hazel.hiding.0.text: The festival wants someone to read aloud. Ione said my name. (I've been back here an hour.) Is that strange?
dlg.hazel.hiding.0.why: 'since ten' broke when the scene plays at nine

event.hazel_heart8.intro.text: Would you hear a thing I wrote? (I tried it on the gray cat. It left at line three.)
event.hazel_heart8.intro.why: 'Just you' belongs to heart 10; the cat is the returns-box cat

event.hazel_heart10.outro.text: {if choice:hazel.rehearsal.critique}I cut the middle. (You were right. It breathes now.) The new line is about you. (It may hang on a lantern this winter. May.){else}I kept the lamp. And I added you, third line from the end. (It may hang on a lantern this winter. May.){/if}
event.hazel_heart10.outro.why: both branches no longer echo heart 8's 'What did you hear'; thread to the winter lantern from the bible

event.hazel_friend.fallback.text: Come back with blackberries? (No hurry. It has waited this long. One more day won't show.)
event.hazel_friend.fallback.why: the ask already said forty-one years; no second count

event.hazel_friend.success.text: Perfect. One tart, then a knock on the borrower's door. (He may not forgive the library. He will eat.)
event.hazel_friend.success.why: 'his door' had no referent; now the borrower is named as such

event.hazel_birthday.after.text: {if choice:bday.hazel.wish}I wrote them in the margin of today. (In ink. I never use ink.){else}{if choice:bday.hazel.read}My favorite line, in your voice. (The keeper will sound like you now. I don't mind.){else}A shared silence. The quietest birthday I've had. (Next year, again, please.){/if}{/if}
event.hazel_birthday.after.why: wish branch no longer repeats r0's 'two words'; read branch gives 'sounds truer' back to partners

event.hazel_courtship.intro.text: May I ask something plainly? Would you like to court me? (I had a longer version. It had an index.)
event.hazel_courtship.intro.why: 'Four drafts' repeated heart 5's draft count; 'footnote' belongs to r1

event.hazel_partners.intro.text: A page. One page, not a book. I wrote it for us. Please sit and read it with me.
event.hazel_partners.intro.why: no longer opens like heart 5 ('I wrote you something')

dlg.hazel.partners.0.text: The afternoon is ours. (Ione insisted. She's gone to dust something far away.) How shall we spend it?
dlg.hazel.partners.0.why: '(You came.)' made no sense mid-scene and echoed the birthday; sets up Ione walking past twice

event.reading_night.borrowed.text: Hazel reads two borrowed pages about the winter sea, quietly, all the way through. Her sleeve stays shut.
event.reading_night.borrowed.why: the choice is Hazel reading something borrowed; the old narration had Ione read

event.overheard_hazel_ione_1.l1.text: The spring almanac. Third shelf, left, behind the mysteries. (Someone sorted those by color.)
event.overheard_hazel_ione_1.l1.why: Ione answers 'You found it', so Hazel now names what she found

event.overheard_hazel_ione_1.l3.text: Then we split it. You dust, I shelve. (The quiet stays undivided.)
event.overheard_hazel_ione_1.l3.why: repeats Ione's 'dust' instead of 'sweep'; no longer all aside

event.overheard_hazel_ione_2.l4.text: Once a year, yes. (I fine myself four cents a time. I'm up to twenty-eight.)
event.overheard_hazel_ione_2.l4.why: 'eleven' was wallpaper; the sum is precise

event.overheard_hazel_ione_3.l2.text: Oh. (It's for me.) ...I'm not going to say anything. It would only echo.
event.overheard_hazel_ione_3.l2.why: Ione replies 'You didn't say a word'; the old line said thank you aloud

event.overheard_dorian_hazel_1.l2.text: Dorian. Hello. (The bench has room. Sit, if you like.)

event.overheard_dorian_hazel_1.l4.text: (The best kind.) I brought two books. One is for not reading.
event.overheard_dorian_hazel_1.l4.why: no longer repeats 'as you like' from l2

event.overheard_hazel_piper_3.l4.text: (Not my name.) Just play it. Loudly. (It was always meant to be loud.)
event.overheard_hazel_piper_3.l4.why: piper_2 already ends at the back behind a book

threads.hazel_heart2: Who pencilled the first frost three days early beside the snowdrop, and why does she keep only one chair?
threads.hazel_heart5: What is wrong with line four, and will she ever read the poem aloud?
threads.hazel_heart4: Return date: whenever; what will she recommend back?
threads.hazel_heart6: Will she answer Ione about the festival reading by Friday?
threads.hazel_heart8: Two listeners, perhaps: who will the second be?
threads.hazel_heart10: Will the poem hang on a winter lantern?
threads.hazel_friend: Who is the borrower forty-one years overdue, and will he forgive the library?
threads.hazel_birthday: A margin, a keeper's voice, or next year's silence: she keeps what the player gave.
threads.hazel_courtship: The second chair for the nook, or the place the shelf keeps.
threads.hazel_partners: The page with the player's name in pencil, the walk, or Ione walking past twice.
threads.reading_night: What stayed in Hazel's sleeve, if she did not read it?
threads.overheard_hazel_ione_1: Who sorted the mysteries by color?
threads.overheard_hazel_ione_2: Which very long book has she been finishing for seven years?
threads.overheard_hazel_ione_3: The window chair is hers now; will she ever say thank you aloud?
threads.overheard_dorian_hazel_1: What is the book for not reading?
threads.overheard_dorian_hazel_2: The maple leaf from the library step, added to Dorian's guide.
threads.overheard_dorian_hazel_3: The window seat, saved for two silences.
threads.overheard_wren_hazel_1: Hazel writes down all three versions of Wren's stories.
threads.overheard_wren_hazel_2: One line at the corner stool, possibly by spring.
threads.overheard_wren_hazel_3: Which line will she read Wren?
threads.overheard_hazel_piper_1: Who is fixing Piper's rhymes in neat pencil?
threads.overheard_hazel_piper_2: Hazel has been listening every Thursday.
threads.overheard_hazel_piper_3: The verse in the fiddle case stays unsigned.
